units.title: Automotive Battery 1.1 Battery Maintenance and safety precautions
topics: - Precaution steps taken while servicing battery. - Visually inspect for damage or corrosion. - Cleaning of battery terminals and connectors. - Topping up electrolyte (for lead acid battery) 1.2 Battery diagnosis and troubleshooting: - Identifying common battery-related issues. - Symptoms of a weak or faulty battery. - Diagnosing battery drain or parasitic draw. - Different trouble causes and remedies of the battery. 1.3 Battery Testing: - Various terminology is used for battery testing. - Voltage measurement using a multimeter

Cadmium test. - Testing via battery analyzer. - Interpreting battery test results. 1.4 Battery Charging and jump start: - Various charging processes and their use. - Step-by-step process of connecting jumper cables correctly and safely

units.title: Automotive Starting system
topics: 3.1 Maintenance of Starting system. - Safety precaution during Maintenance and service of Starting system. 3.2 Diagnosis of Starting system - Diagnostic Procedures for Identifying Starting System Faults. - Troubleshooting Procedure and starting system problem with remedies and action plan. 3.3 Testing of Starting system - Visual inspection test. - Control circuit test. - Starter circuit voltage drop test. - Starter amperage test. - Starter motor field coil

growler armature and runout test. 3.4 Overhauling of starting system. - Disassembly and assembly with precise safety of starting system components. - Proper inspection and testing of each component i.e. solenoid
bench test. 3.5 Recycling and disposal of starting system
